messages:
maria.g: Quick run-down—need owners for all customer-facing follow-ups after the partial outage last night. Who can own the 72-hour brief, the status page blurb, and the RCA access rules?
ryan.k: Ill take the status page blurb and a single-line public note about recurrence. Will keep it non-technical.
samir.b: Ill draft the RCA access tiers and a short redaction checklist (3 bullets).
beth: Looping in @olivia.p for legal signoff on any sharing criteria and consent language.
olivia.p: I can review. We should require an explicit consent record before sharing anything more than the 72h redacted summary.
maria.g: Required outputs: 72-hour customer brief (non-technical), a 3-question FAQ for support, status page sentence, and a clear gate for deeper RCA access.
ryan.k: Draft status blurb (v0): "Partial disruption to hosted inference (May 9, 2026)—some requests experienced service delays following a recent configuration change. Service restored at 03:18 UTC. A customer summary will be posted within 72 hours." Thoughts?
maria.g: Good. Add one sentence: "We are investigating a recurring class of incidents and will post mitigations when confirmed." Keep it high-level.
samir.b: Proposed access tiers: (1) Redacted customer summary—publish within 72h to impacted customers; (2) Detailed redacted timeline and mitigations—available within 7 business days; (3) Deeper technical packet—enterprise only, on request, requires documented consent/NDA. Redaction checklist: remove PII, internal hostnames, raw IPs, and sensitive control specifics.
olivia.p: Legal OK with tiers. Require the customer to sign a short consent form before we share diagrams/traces. Also log who gets materials.
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-8001 "Publish 72h customer brief" — assignee: maria.g — due: 1961390000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-8002 "Status page blurb + recurrence sentence" — assignee: ryan.k — due: 1961320000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-8003 "RCA access tiers & redaction checklist" — assignee: samir.b — due: 1961350000
maria.g: Recap of owners: 72h brief = maria.g; status blurb = ryan.k; RCA policy + checklist = samir.b; legal review & consent template = olivia.p + beth. Please keep customer-facing wording identical across status page, support replies, and direct email. Ill drop the 72h draft here for quick approval. End.
